title: Cruickshank's archival research into Kennedy records and MJ12

tellings.quote: like Jeff Krookshank have done a little bit have done like the forensic historical kind of uh deep dive look through the Kennedy archives

plain: The claim is that a researcher named Jeff Cruickshank has dug through the archives of President John F. Kennedy, looking at declassified records from the 1960s alongside the MJ12 documents, papers said to describe a secret group of twelve that handled UFO matters. A guest named Matthew Pines mentions this in passing, calling it a forensic, historical deep dive, without naming his source. If the work holds up, it would test whether those papers fit the real Kennedy-era record.
